_comment: wall_painting2 on Unitree H1-2. Same source clip and same GVHMR prediction as the G1
version; only the retarget target differs. H1-2's grip span is 0.873 m (G1: 0.503 m)
because GMR scales the human motion to the robot, so it holds `roller_h1_2`: the same
head on a pole 0.370 m longer at the bottom. The left grip stays 0.197 m below the roller
origin as on G1, so axis_offset = 0.197 + 0.873 = 1.070 and the right grip sits at
local z -1.070. contact_target_pos_offset is ordered [left, right] to match
Packed with gmr_to_hdmi.py --trim 3: -- the first 3 GMR frames (0.1 s) are an IK
start-up transient (hip yaw 7.2 rad/s, torso 6.6 rad/s at 50 fps frames 0-1) that made
every frame-0 episode fail. Segment ends past the trimmed length are clipped.
